data.narrative:
Critical Loop, a Series A climate and energy company founded by Bala Ramamurthy, has raised $49M to date. The valuation exercise draws on a sector universe of nine climate and energy peers—one public (LNZA) and eight private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though direct comparables at the same stage remain sparse.

Given insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage peers with comparable valuation tiers (fewer than three datapoints in each narrow filter), peer-median methodology was not applied. Instead, the analysis relies on stage-progression, applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $49M total raised proxy, yielding $98M. This single-method triangulation produces a range of $83M (low) to $113M (high), with $98M as the median point.

The analysis supports a valuation of approximately $98M, with a credible range of $83M–$113M. Key uncertainties include the absence of a robust same-stage comparable set in climate and energy, limiting confidence in sector-specific benchmarking, and dependence on a single methodological input. Validation would benefit from additional near-peer financials or revenue/unit economics data specific to Critical Loop's business model.
